subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A news report showed a floating farm built on water.”?
options: The teacher gave him another sheet and said, "Slow hands can still learn."
This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.
Their teacher said new ideas should be tested with both hope and doubt.
The engineer said, "Testing exists because hope and doubt both need evidence."

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The teacher gave him another sheet and said, 'Slow hands can still learn.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Their teacher said new ideas should be tested with both hope and doubt.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
